description: Source code for a Bluetooth Low Energy central device that performs MTU exchange, device discovery, and subscription to notifications using Zephyr RTOS Bluetooth APIs.

methods.name: notify_func
methods.description: Handles GATT notifications and calls user callback if set.

methods.name: discover_func
methods.description: Handles GATT discovery process, subscribing to characteristics and descriptors.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Callback for device discovery, initiates connection to nearby devices.

methods.name: mtu_exchange
methods.description: Performs MTU exchange with connected device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles BLE connection establishment, initiates discovery and MTU exchange.

methods.name: run_central_sample
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, sets callback, and starts scanning.
